manual.redstone_timer.line2: The timer is a redstone device that uses an oscillating quartz crystal to output a signal at regular intervals.{0}
manual.redstone_timer.line3: Using the Engineer's Screwdriver on the timer allows configuring its interval and its output signal colour.{0}
manual.redstone_timer.line4: Additionally, the timer can be set to require a control signal, at which point it will not run without that signal being high.
